name: Mean Dolphin 24
author: cssbuttons-io
description: Gradient pill gray toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background changes from repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #c8c8c8 0%, #c8c8c8 2%, transparent 2%, transparent 3%, #c8c8c8 3%, transparent 3%), conic-gradient(#ffffff 0%, #c0c0c0 10%, #ffffff 35%, #c0c0c0 45%, #ffffff 60%, #c0c0c0 70%, #ffffff 80%, #c0c0c0 95%, #ffffff 100%) to #13d162, left becomes calc(100% - 35px + 10px).
